QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 6 (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: You brought the Red Ink to Stew, but he seems to have another request.
QuestInfo.1: The key to the Speaking Hall broke and they need a new key immediately.
QuestInfo.2: Hurry the items over to Stew.

0.0: Today's been nothing but a trainwreck! I thought we were ready to go, and now I find out that Zeno is down there wrecking the Speaking Hall, trying to find a t-shirt that fits him.
0.1: I'm flattered that he liked them so much but...\n(You hear something crunch.)
0.2:
Oh no. Oh my goodness no. The key to the hall! I broke the key!
You have to help me. 
I think there's a guide online... do you think maybe you could, uh, help out a little?

yes.0: Okay, it says we need 1 Advanced Mold, 1 Advanced Abrasive, and 1 Steel Plate. That's gonna help somehow. I think.

no.0: I knew this was going to happen.

yes.0: All right! I hope this walkthrough is telling me the truth.\n(Stew starts working on the key.)\nDone!! I can't believe that worked.

item.0: Are you joking?! Weren't you rambling about being champion of freedom?!
